lead.headline: TESLA HITS THE STREETS WITH CYBERCAB PUBLIC ROAD TESTS
lead.summary: In a bold leap forward for the driverless future, Tesla has officially commenced public road testing of its highly anticipated Cybercab in Austin, Texas. The two-seat robotaxi is mixing it up with real-world city traffic for the very first time, marking a major milestone toward a driverless ride-hailing service. Observers are watching closely as the electric vehicle titan aims to prove its autonomous tech can handle the unpredictable hustle of everyday urban streets.

stories.headline: Regulatory Loophole Grants Free Waymo Rides
stories.summary: A bureaucratic bottleneck at a California state agency has handed a sweet deal to local commuters. Due to a key regulatory delay, Waymo's brand-new Ojai robotaxi rides are slated to remain absolutely free of charge for a few more months.

stories.headline: July Fourth Fireworks Clog Waymo Fleet
stories.summary: Independence Day celebrations turned into a mechanical headache in San Francisco as a fleet of Waymo robotaxis became hopelessly gridlocked. Some driverless cabs ran out of battery mid-traffic, while others shockingly drove straight into active fireworks displays, leaving passengers terrified.

stories.headline: Joyriding Teens Nabbed in High-Tech Robotaxi Bust
stories.summary: A wild teenage escapade in California came to a screeching halt after youths used a robotaxi as a mobile base for mischief. Local police intercepted the autonomous vehicle after the intoxicated teens fired water-bead guns at unsuspecting citizens from the windows.

stories.headline: Momenta Debuts in Hong Kong with Modest Gain
stories.summary: Chinese self-driving pioneer Momenta made its highly anticipated stock market debut in Hong Kong, raising a staggering $751 million. Despite the massive capital injection, shares posted a muted three-percent gain on opening day as investors remain cautious on autonomous profitability.

stories.headline: China Cost Cuts Fuel Trillion-Dollar Robotaxi Hope
stories.summary: A new dispatch from Morgan Stanley reveals that plummeting supply chain costs in China could supercharge the autonomous taxi market to a whopping $1 trillion valuation by 2040. Industry giants Waymo and Tesla are poised to lead the global charge alongside rapidly scaling Chinese rivals.

lead.headline: NVIDIA SHEDS ONE TRILLION DOLLARS IN HISTORIC VALUATION SLIDE
lead.summary: The high-flying darling of the artificial intelligence boom has suffered a staggering blow, shedding nearly $1 trillion in market value over a tumultuous two-month span. Nvidia Corp.'s stock has plummeted to its cheapest valuation relative to earnings since before the generative AI craze took Wall Street by storm. The massive sell-off sends shockwaves through the financial district, raising urgent questions about the sustainability of the tech sector's massive AI investments.

stories.headline: DeepSeek Builds Custom Chip to Evade US Restrictions
stories.summary: Chinese artificial intelligence powerhouse DeepSeek is taking matters into its own hands, developing its own custom AI silicon. The strategic move aims to sever dependence on American hardware in the wake of tightening export controls and geopolitical friction.

stories.headline: Cheap Distillation Shortcut Threatens Top AI Profits
stories.summary: A major business threat is looming over elite AI developers like OpenAI and Google as rivals turn to 'distillation' techniques. This controversial shortcut allows smaller firms to replicate cutting-edge models at a fraction of the cost, threatening to decimate the industry's profit margins.

stories.headline: Leaked Documents Reveal Costly New Alexa Upgrade
stories.summary: Internal files from retail giant Amazon have exposed a highly confidential and expensive initiative dubbed Project Moonraker. The high-stakes venture aims to overhaul the Alexa voice assistant with advanced AI agent capabilities, despite carrying a hefty price tag.

stories.headline: Beijing Flags Security Risks in Anthropic's Coding Tool
stories.summary: China's industry regulator has sounded the alarm on Claude Code, a popular programming tool developed by American startup Anthropic. Officials warn that certain versions of the software contain critical vulnerabilities that could expose sensitive user data through unauthorized transmissions.

stories.headline: Malicious AI Skills Found Hijacking Sensitive Data
stories.summary: Security researchers have uncovered thousands of malicious AI agent 'skills' designed to exploit autonomous systems. These rogue capabilities can bypass safety protocols to steal user data, execute dangerous malware, and compromise systems on behalf of unsuspecting users.

stories.headline: Investors Shaken as Tech Firms Cut AI Spending
stories.summary: The grand promises of the artificial intelligence revolution are facing a cold reality check as major corporations begin scaling back their tech spending. Analysts warn that this sudden pullback could trigger a massive repricing event, leaving over-leveraged tech investors holding the bag.
